name: 8ightDAO
rootCause: Although this is our first story taking place on the Harmony chain, there’s nothing new about the protocol. Another Olympus fork, another set of "compromised keys". $1.75M gone.

descriptions.text: Although this is our first story taking place on the Harmony chain, there’s nothing new about the protocol. Another Olympus fork, another set of "compromised keys". $1.75M gone.

8ight Finance on the Harmony chain was hacked, and $1.75 million was stolen due to the leak of the private key due to google doc. The platform tweeted about the loss yesterday, and in its discord server provided an explanation for the loss of funds: "Two developers on the team have the keys and they were sent via Facebook group chat and google drive. This is our first project, so we have to admit that our opsec is low.”

8ightDAO suffered a treasury drain on Harmony after its admin private key was compromised through unsafe online sharing. Roughly $1.75 million was lost as the attacker withdrew assets and moved them to Tornado Cash. No funds have been reported recovered. Private key compromise: The admin treasury key was reportedly shared via Facebook chat and Google Drive, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access and theft.

8ight Finance disclosed in early December 2021 that its Harmony treasury had been drained after the treasury private key was shared through Facebook chat and Google Drive. Public reporting put the loss near $1.75 million, but the attacker identity and the full cross-chain path into Tornado Cash remain only partially verified. The reported cause was compromise of a treasury private key that had been shared insecurely through Facebook chat and Google Drive, with no effective multisig barrier preventing a single key holder from moving treasury assets. Public evidence does not establish whether the key was stolen by an external attacker or used by an insider.
